standing: HELD — a normalization Akien asked for before going on. Every row is RED (Law 9): this is a translation of the picture in his head, drawn so he can say 'nope, a little more left'. Nothing here is built, and the schema is not enforced anywhere.
why_held: Akien drew the pipeline as alternating process/artifact and then asked the normalizing question: what IS a step? It has a name, a trigger, a thing it consumes, a thing it emits, a way it completes, and a kind (joint with him / mine / a device's). That question is answerable, and answering it turns two standing aims from feelings into column-counts.
akien_verbatim: idea (trigger: skill) -> idea (prose artifact) in ideas folder / idea (process, trigger?) -> (ends with?) intention (artifact) + idea marked transformed -> design (process, trigger?) -> (ends with: /sorted) -> tickets (artifacts) -> chart (skill/process) -> (artifact, add ticket data) -> build (process) -> proposed code (artifact) -> tester (device/process) -> validation (artifact) -> watchme (process) -> watcher (probe, artifact and process) -> learning (feedback/artifact)

what is a step? it's a name. how is it triggered? what does it consume? what does it emit? how does it complete? it might be a process we do together, it might be an artifact, or a process some device does.
steal their measurement with our mechanisms

the_normalizing_move.claim: A STEP IS A PROCESS. An artifact is not a step — it is how a step COMPLETES.
the_normalizing_move.why: Akien's list alternates process, artifact, process, artifact. Given the five questions he asked, only the processes can answer them: an artifact has no trigger, consumes nothing, and emits itself. Asking the five questions of an artifact produces a degenerate row that adds nothing — the reify trap.
the_normalizing_move.what_it_collapses: 'what does it emit?' and 'how does it complete?' are the SAME question for every step but one. A step completes when its emitted artifact is through its door. That is Law 4 and Law 8 applied to the pipeline itself: completion is evidence, not assertion.
the_normalizing_move.the_one_exception_is_load_bearing: The probe. It emits repeatedly, on a clock nobody controls, and completes on RETIREMENT rather than on emission. That is the only step where emit and complete come apart — and it is exactly why LEARNME as a workflow STATE was wrong. A state parks the boat; the probe's output is not on the boat's clock. Akien's standing ruling already said WATCHME completes when the probe is CREATED. This derives that ruling from the schema instead of remembering it.
the_normalizing_move.so_learning_is_not_a_step: 'learning (feedback/artifact)' is the probe's emission, not a ninth step. It is inbound mail to a node that may already be PROVED. Nothing in the system currently CONSUMES it — see [[held-feedback-loops-have-addresses]].

the_step_schema.name: the step's name — its handle everywhere else
the_step_schema.trigger: what FIRES it. An event, never a clock. Today most of these are 'Akien types a slash command', which is honest and is the thing being retired.
the_step_schema.consumes: the TYPED artifact it takes in. The type matters: it must equal the previous step's `emits` or the seam is a gap.
the_step_schema.completes: the predicate that makes it done. For every step but the probe: 'the emitted artifact passed its door'.
the_step_schema.kind: joint (Akien + CC) | mine (CC alone) | device (a component, unattended). This is a DIAL, not a taxonomy — the whole cocoon aim is steps migrating rightward. See [[cocoon-settle-stages-around-cc]].
the_step_schema.door: what refuses an incomplete emission. A step with no door completes by assertion, which is Law 4's IOU.

the_steps.name: capture
the_steps.trigger: Akien has an idea and says so. ENTRY POINT — the only step whose input is outside the system (the picture in his head). Nothing upstream can fire it.
the_steps.completes: the file exists in the ideas folder
the_steps.door: NONE — and there is no /idea skill and no ideas/ folder today. Both are red.
the_steps.note: IDEA is entry point #1 of the three ruled 2026-08-02 (IDEA, INTENT, TICKET). The folder is a QUEUE; naming it that makes the eventual firing event obvious rather than inventing one now.

the_steps.name: intend
the_steps.akien_called_it: idea (process, trigger?) -> intention + idea marked transformed
the_steps.trigger: ANSWERED FROM THE CORPUS, not owed to Akien: there is no trigger and none is needed. Ideas sit in the queue; the reach for one IS the event. /intent's door is the filter — an idea that cannot answer WHAT/HOW/trace/shape/falsifier routes OUT, which is already built and already recorded as an exit.
the_steps.emits: a berth (node in intention fill-state, traced, challenged) AND the source idea marked transformed
the_steps.completes: the berth path is printed by the door
the_steps.door: cairn.skill_block fire intent — BUILT, refuses an incomplete packet, refuses a birth with no /challenge answers
the_steps.gap: The back-reference. /intent today consumes CONVERSATION, not an idea file, and nothing marks the idea transformed. Akien wrote that half explicitly and it does not exist. This is the same shape as the charter `entry` field: provenance of where a thing came from.

the_steps.name: design
the_steps.trigger: ANSWERED FROM THE CORPUS: a berth exists in intention fill-state and is not yet cast. That is a PREDICATE ON A BERTH — an observable state, therefore something a shim could fire on, not a thing Akien has to remember.
the_steps.emits: cast tickets (typed, gates bound, watch answered)
the_steps.gap: THIS STEP HAS NO SKILL. It is the unnamed middle: /challenge fires at its start (at birth), /sorted closes it, and the process between them is conversation with no shape. It is the longest step in the chain and the only one with no artifact of its own.

the_steps.name: chart
the_steps.trigger: a cast ticket is about to become a build; /sail refuses without a chart chain, so the refusal is itself a trigger
the_steps.emits: build packet (seven nexus stages, per-field provenance)
the_steps.completes: all seven stages through their schema gates
the_steps.door: the seven chart doors — BUILT, refuse complete in one pass, accumulate-then-raise
the_steps.note: The most complete step in the chain: it is the only one with named sub-stages, each gated. It is the model the others should be measured against.

the_steps.name: build
the_steps.completes: code exists — NOT that it is right
the_steps.door: /sail refuses on a missing chart chain — BUILT
the_steps.note: 'Proposed' is doing real work in Akien's word choice: this step's completion predicate is deliberately weak, because the next step is what makes it true. Law 9 lives in that word.

the_steps.name: test
the_steps.completes: the seal is written through the validation door
the_steps.kind: DEVICE — the only fully-device step in the whole chain today
the_steps.door: validation_store.persist_validation — BUILT, append-only, though a live trouble says it is not the only path to the file

the_steps.name: watchme
the_steps.emits: a probe — addressed to wherever feedback has to come from (gateway, time, future event)
the_steps.completes: THE PROBE IS CREATED. Ruled by Akien; the state does not wait for what the probe finds.

the_steps.name: watch
the_steps.trigger: whatever the probe was addressed to
the_steps.completes: RETIREMENT, not emission — the only step where these come apart
the_steps.note: BaseShim already carries the three memories this needs (_was_true anti-bounce, _cleared terminal/retired, _first_seen feeding overdue()). The retirement predicate is _cleared. That is prior art in-house, not something to design fresh.

what_normalizing_revealed.1_the_workflow_states_are_a_projection_o: THINKME~design, TICKETME~/sorted casting, BUILDME~chart+build, PROVEME~test, PROVED~validation sealed, WATCHME~watchme. The pipeline is the SYSTEM's view; the stage is ONE NODE's view of the same seams. This is why 'a workflow is composed at ticketing time by the ticketer' (Akien, same turn as the ticket/probe/task tree): the workflow is a per-instance selection of these steps.
what_normalizing_revealed.2_the_two_ends_have_no_physics_and_that_: The workflow states cover the MIDDLE only. Before THINKME (capture, intend) the boat does not exist yet; after WATCHME (watch, learning) it has already docked. Those are exactly the two ends with no stage, no cursor, and no door — and exactly the two ends we independently know are missing (no /idea skill, no ideas folder; no address for feedback). The gap in the physics and the gap in the pipeline are the same gap.
what_normalizing_revealed.3_the_trigger_column_is_the_footprint_di: Count the triggers that are 'Akien types a command': capture, intend, design, and effectively chart and build. That is 5 of 8. The founding intention is getting Akien out of running the system; this column makes the distance COUNTABLE instead of felt. Every step whose trigger becomes an observable predicate is one fewer thing he has to remember. Kin [[shrinking-footprint-event-not-poll]].
what_normalizing_revealed.4_the_kind_column_is_the_cocoon_dial: joint -> mine -> device. Today: 1 device (test), 2 nominally-device-but-unbuilt (watchme, watch), 2 mine, 3 joint. The cocoon aim is rows migrating rightward. Also countable, and it is the same table.
what_normalizing_revealed.5_type_matching_across_seams_is_a_mechan: If step N's `emits` does not equal step N+1's `consumes`, the seam is a gap. Run it: capture emits 'idea record' but intend consumes CONVERSATION (gap, and it is Akien's own '?'). design emits 'cast tickets' but chart consumes 'a request' (gap — chart's input is not typed as a ticket). chart->build, build->test, test->watchme all match. Two gaps, both real, both found by the check rather than by reading.
what_normalizing_revealed.6_the_door_column_is_law_9_on_the_pipeli: A step with a door completes on evidence. A step without one completes because someone says so. Built doors: intend, design(cast), chart, build, test. Missing: capture, watchme, watch. Three red steps, and they are the three at the ends.

the_challenge_pass.better_approach: The plainest alternative is to skip the schema and just fix the two gaps Akien marked with '?'. Rejected because the schema is what FOUND the third gap (chart's untyped input) and both dials, at the cost of one table. But the schema must not be built into enforcement yet — see hidden_assumption.
the_challenge_pass.prior_art: In-house: the workflow state string, the /chart nexus stages, BaseShim's three memories, [[held-workflow-belongs-to-the-author]], [[held-feedback-loops-have-addresses]], [[held-inspectors-janitors-filters]]. External, cited not grafted: superpowers' plan/task structure names Consumes/Produces per task with exact signatures for the same reason — so a step's neighbours are typed. Idea borrowed, no bytes.
the_challenge_pass.hidden_assumption: That the pipeline is LINEAR. It is not: /intent routes nodes OUT, /sorted spawns children, a ticket can enter directly at TICKET without an idea or an intention. This table is the SPINE, and a spine is not the whole skeleton. Any enforcement built from it must handle branch and exit or it will refuse legitimate shapes.
the_challenge_pass.real_collision: Checked 'step' against 'stage' and 'stratum'. Not a collision — finding 1 says a stage is a step seen from one node. But the words are close enough to drift, and Akien used 'step' first here, so 'step' is the pipeline's unit and 'stage' stays the node's. Flagging the near-miss out loud rather than letting it blur. Kin [[terms-drift-flag-coinages]].
the_challenge_pass.back_up: PROCEED, as a held note. Do not cast, do not enforce, do not build the schema check. Akien asked for coherence before going on; this is the translation for him to correct.

what_must_be_built_eventually: Nothing yet — this is held. The candidates, unranked and uncast: the ideas queue + /idea door; the idea->intention back-reference; a name for the design step; typing chart's input as a ticket; a door at watchme; the address feedback lands on.

The one with physics behind it: emits/consumes type-matching as a compiled check, so a seam gap is a build error rather than something read off a table by hand. That is the compile-one-level-further move, and it is what would keep this note from becoming a thing to re-derive.
open_and_deliberately_unanswered: Whether 'design' should have a skill at all, or whether it is correctly the one step that stays conversational — the place where the picture in Akien's head enters, which by [[spec-lives-in-akiens-head]] is the one thing no device can take over. If that is true, design is not a gap; it is the irreducible joint step, and the honest schema should say so rather than mark it red.
